pmacct_user.description: System user account under which pmacctd runs for privilege separation.

pmacct_group.description: System group for the pmacct process.

log_file.description: Path to the main log file. Set to 'syslog' or '' for syslog-only logging.

daemonize.description: Run pmacctd as a background daemon (true) or foreground (false).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for daemon control.

interface.description: Network interface (e.g., eth0) or 'any' to capture on all interfaces.

promisc.description: Enable promiscuous mode to capture all traffic on the interface.

snaplen.description: Maximum number of bytes to capture per packet (min 96, max 65535).

plugins.description: List of output plugins to use (e.g., memory, sql, kafka, syslog, bgp).

aggregate.description: Key fields used to aggregate flows (comma-separated, e.g., src_host, dst_host, src_port).

memory_limit.description: Maximum memory to use for internal accounting tables (e.g., '256M', '1G').

accounting_interval.description: Time (in seconds) between exports/flushes of accounting data.

sql_enabled.description: Enable SQL output plugin (PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB).

sql_db.description: Name of the SQL database for accounting data.

sql_pass.description: SQL password (empty if using peer/auth or keyring).

sql_port.description: SQL server port (5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL).

sql_table.description: Table name to store accounting data.

kafka_topic.description: Kafka topic name for accounting messages.

kafka_brokers.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses.

nfacctd_conf.description: Relative filename of the nfacctd configuration file under /etc/pmacct/.
